entities.summary: Antônio Domingos Brescovit is a Brazilian arachnologist. His first name, Antônio, may also be spelled António. He develops academic activities at the 'arthropodae laboratorium' at the Butantan Institute, and he is a specialist in Neotropical Arachnida. Antonio Domingos Brescovit was a naturalists & biologists from Brazil (b. 1959). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
